t.why: In neighboring eastern DRC, the M23 rebels seized major cities such as Goma and Bukavu in early 2025, and UN experts say Rwanda backs them. Fearing the fighting could reach its border, Burundi has sent thousands of troops to fight alongside the Congolese army. Its border with Rwanda has been closed since January 2024 over accusations that Rwanda backs Burundian rebels.
t.rel: A neighbor with an ethnic makeup similar to Rwanda's, with frequent tension between the two. It has sent troops to help the Congolese army fight the M23 rebels in eastern DRC.
t.know: It has one of the lowest incomes per person in the world.
t.etext: Most people live from farming, and coffee and tea are the main exports. One of the poorest countries in the world, it is always short of foreign currency.
